# Lanternfall

A lantern-lit action RPG for the Flipper Zero. Explore a procedural island of villages, fields, forests and coast, fight what lives out there, and find your way home when the lanterns come on.

## The world

- A 256 by 256 tile island made fresh for each new journey, with villages of houses, lanterns, a well, a merchant and a notice board
- Townsfolk with things to say, which change with the time, the weather and the village
- A full day and night: dusk darkens the land, night leaves only lantern light and the glow of your own lamp
- Rain, and storms with thunder and lightning
- A map that fills in as you explore

## The fight

- Slimes, wolves that hunt in pairs, boars that charge in a straight line, and shades that only walk at night
- Every enemy winds up before it strikes, so you can read it and step away
- Creatures get tougher the further you go from the first village
- Levels, weapons, armour and lamps from the merchant, and loot to sell
- Hunting quests from the notice board in every village
- Villages are safe: nothing hostile follows you in, and you mend faster there

## Hands free

- **Auto-attack** swings at anything beside you when your weapon is ready
- **Idle** plays on by itself: it fights what it can take, eats when badly hurt and rests when out of food. **Near** stays close to where you left it; **Roam** sets off for country you have not seen yet. Press any button to take over.

## Controls

- D-pad: walk (hold to keep walking)
- OK: attack, talk, trade, read a notice board, drink at a well
- Hold OK: eat bread
- Back: pause menu (idle, bag, hero, map, settings, save and quit)
- Hold Back: save and quit

Settings cover auto-attack, idle range, sound, vibration, LED, backlight, screen shake, lightning flash and rain. The game saves to the SD card.
